blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in restoring high-quality images in a zero-shot manner. Unfortunately, extending this success to video restoration is challenging due to the substantial computational resources required to pre-train video diffusion models. A rising trend seeks to address video restoration by utilizing a pre-trained image diffusion model, initiating restoration from either frame-wise independent or identical Gaussian noise. Yet, these approaches often fall short, as such simple noise initiations fail to capture and utilize the inherent temporal correlations within degraded video frames. In this work, we propose taming noise initialization for zero-shot video restoration, which preserves the intrinsic temporal correlations by generating initial noises directly using DDIM inversion on the corrupted video frames themselves. Building on this, we introduce an adaptive noise blending strategy that suppresses degradation patterns encoded during DDIM inversion while gradually steering the noise toward a Gaussian distribution. To further emphasize temporal consistency, we propose measurement-guided trajectory attention to better align features across frames. Extensive experiments on multiple video restoration tasks demonstrate that our method outperforms existing zero-shot approaches, consistently achieving superior results on the DAVIS, REDS4, and Set8 datasets.
blocks.zh: 最近传播模型的进步在以零镜头方式恢复高品质图像方面取得了显著成功. 不幸的是,将这一成功推广到视频修复方面具有挑战性,因为预先培训视频传播模型需要大量的计算资源。 一种上升趋势试图通过使用经过预先训练的图像传播模型来解决视频恢复问题,从帧式独立或相同的高斯噪音开始恢复。 然而,这些方法往往不够充分,因为这种简单的噪音起动无法捕捉和利用已退化的视频框架内固有的时间相关性。 在这部作品中,我们提出将噪声驯化初始化为零镜头视频修复,通过直接使用DDIM倒置在被腐蚀的视频帧上产生初始噪声来保存固有的时间相关性. 在此基础上,我们引入了适应性噪声混合策略,抑制DDIM倒置期间所编码的降解模式,同时将噪声逐渐引导到高斯分布. 为了进一步强调时间上的一致性,我们建议以衡量为指南的轨迹注意更好地调整跨框架的特征。 多项视频修复任务的广泛实验表明,我们的方法比现有的零镜头方法要好,在DAVIS、REDS4和Set8数据集上不断取得优异的结果。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Denoising diffusion models [ 2 ] have demonstrated exceptional performance in synthesizing images and videos with promising perceptual quality [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] .
Recently, such effectiveness in modeling complex distributions has motivated a wide application in both image and video-based restoration tasks [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] . While task-specific diffusion models achieve impressive results on their targeted problems, they frequently struggle with generalizability across various restoration tasks. Instead, another line of research tends to exploit the generative power inherent in a pre-trained diffusion network to address various image restoration problems in a zero-shot manner [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ] .
blocks.zh:
Denoising display models [2] 在合成具有有希望的感知质量的图像和视频[3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9] 方面表现出非凡的性能.
最近,这种在模拟复杂分发方面的效力促使人们广泛应用图像和视频修复任务[10、11、12、13、14、15、16、17]。 虽然针对具体任务的传播模式在目标问题上取得了令人印象深刻的成果,但它们往往在各种恢复任务中遇到笼统的问题。 相反,另一行研究倾向于利用预先训练的传播网络中固有的遗传力,以零镜头的方式解决各种图像恢复问题[18,19,20,21,22].

blocks.en:
Despite the success of zero-shot approaches in image restoration, extending these achievements to video restoration poses significant challenges.
Pre-training video diffusion models from scratch requires substantial computational resources, making it impractical for various applications. Consequently, how to effectively address zero-shot video restoration remains largely underexplored.
Very recently, researchers have attempted to bridge this gap by adapting pre-trained image diffusion models for video restoration without retraining [ 1 , 23 ] . In [ 23 ] , the authors proposed to utilize the temporal consistency guidance to warp the information between frames and prevent temporal misalignment in the restored video. Alternatively, another work [ 1 ] adopts a simple strategy that enforces identical initial noise across frames, thereby ensuring temporal consistency.
blocks.zh:
尽管在图像修复方面零镜头方法取得了成功,但这些成就扩大到视频修复,带来了重大挑战.
从零开始的预训视频传播模型需要大量的计算资源,因此对于各种应用来说不切实际. 因此,如何有效处理零镜头视频修复问题仍然在很大程度上没有得到充分利用。
最近,研究人员试图弥补这一差距,在不进行再培训的情况下,将经过预先培训的图像传播模型用于视频修复[1、23]。 在[23]中,作者建议利用时间一致性指南将信息在帧之间曲解,并防止在恢复的视频中出现时间错配. 另一种做法是,另一工作[1]采用一种简单的策略,跨框架执行相同的初始噪声,从而确保时间的一致性。

blocks.en:
Video, known for its unique characteristics, contains time-correlated scenes and exhibits varying motion dynamics.
However, existing approaches directly start restoration with a simple noise initiation, completely neglecting the temporal correlation across frames.
Specifically, [ 1 ] initializes restoration with identical noise for all frames, imposes an overly strong restriction between frames, potentially constraining the natural dynamics of the restored frames.
Conversely, [ 23 ] adopts frame-wise completely independent Gaussian noises that may allow excessive freedom for each frame, thereby violating the temporal correlation across frames.
Therefore, determining how to appropriately impose temporal correlations during noise initialization is crucial for achieving promising video restoration results. To be more specific, the initialization determines the starting point of the sampling trajectory and strongly affects (i) how well the reverse process stays within the diffusion model learned data manifold, and (ii) how effectively the subsequent steps can correct the trajectory to satisfy the physical degradation model. To this end, we argue that the degraded videos inherently contain sufficient temporally correlated information, which can be effectively utilized to initialize the “right” noise for the diffusion restoration process.
blocks.zh:
视频以其独特的特点而闻名,包含与时间相关的场景和展示不同的运动动态.
然而,现有的方法直接从简单的噪声启动开始恢复,完全忽略了跨帧的时间相关性.
具体来说,[1]对所有帧进行相同的噪声初始化恢复,在帧之间施加过强的限制,可能约束恢复帧的自然动力.
反之,[23]采用框架完全独立 高斯噪音可能允许每个帧过度自由,从而违反跨帧的时间相关性.
因此,在噪音初始化期间确定如何适当规定时间相关性,对于实现有希望的视频恢复结果至关重要。 更具体地说,初始化决定了采样轨迹的起点,并强烈地影响(一) 逆向过程在传播模型中保存得有多多,以及(二) 后续步骤如何有效地纠正轨迹以满足物理降解模型. 为此,我们争辩说,退化的视频内在包含足够的时间关联信息,可以有效地用于初始化传播恢复过程的“正确”噪音。

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose a novel zero-shot framework for video restoration, called TINDER , which only necessitates a pre-trained image diffusion prior.
Motivated by the success of DDIM inversion in video editing [ 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 ] , which establish a deterministic mapping between clean image and the corresponding noise sample. Our method starts by performing DDIM inversion on the degraded video frames to obtain temporally correlated initial noise, effectively preserving temporal correlations and providing essential temporal guidance for the restoration process. Unfortunately, directly applying DDIM inversion in video restoration will produce sub-optimal results since the degradation pattern in the input frames can also be encoded into the inverted noise. To this end, the main contribution of this paper is introducing an adaptive filtering strategy to tame noise initialization for video restoration. Since video sequences inherently exhibit dynamic content, with significant variations in frequency distribution even across consecutive frames.
Thus, our filtering strategy dynamically tailors filters based on the energy distribution of each frame, which is further utilized to blend the DDIM inversion results with Gaussian noise. This strategy not only enables varying yet adaptive filtering on each DDIM inverted noise , but also compensates for the missing high-frequency energy caused by degradation in the inverted noise . Consequently, it steers the DDIM inversion noise towards a Gaussian distribution that better aligns with the diffusion process. To further emphasize temporal consistency, we propose a measurement-guided trajectory attention during the diffusion sampling process.
More in detail, motion trajectories are estimated from adjacent input frames and incorporated into the attention layer of the diffusion network, ensuring temporal consistency between consecutive frames. Finally, the proposed method offers a flexible framework for video restoration, where data consistency can be guaranteed by plugging any existing image-based diffusion sampling strategy. Extensive experiments show that the proposed method consistently achieves superior performances in various video restoration tasks on the DAVIS, REDS4, and Set8 datasets.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们提出一个名为TINDER的视频修复新式零镜头框架,它只需要事先经过训练的图像传播.
由DDIM在视频编辑中反演的成功[24,25,26,27]所激发,确立了清真影像与相应噪声样本之间的决定性映射. 我们的方法首先在退化的视频帧上进行DDIM反演,以获得时间相关的初始噪声,有效保持时间相关性,并为恢复过程提供必要的时间指导. 不幸的是,在视频修复中直接应用DDIM反演将产生次优效果,因为输入框中的降解模式也可以编码成反演噪声. 为此,本文的主要贡献是引入适应性过滤策略,以驯服噪声初始化进行视频修复. 由于视频序列内在表现出动态内容,即使在连续的帧中频率分布也有很大差异.
因此,我们的过滤策略根据每个帧的能量分布动态地调整滤波器,这被进一步用于将DDIM反演结果与高斯噪音混合. 这种策略不仅可以对每个DDIM倒置噪声进行不同但适应性的过滤,而且还可以弥补倒置噪声退化导致的高频能量缺失。 因此,它将DDIM反向噪声引导到更符合扩散过程的高斯分布. 为了进一步强调时间一致性,我们提议在扩散取样过程中对轨迹进行测量指导。
更详细地说,运动轨迹是从相邻的输入帧中估算出来的,并融入扩散网络的注意力层,确保连续帧之间的时间一致性. 最后,拟议方法为视频恢复提供了一个灵活的框架,可以通过插入任何现有的基于图像的传播取样战略来保证数据的一致性。 广泛的实验表明,拟议方法在DAVIS,REDS4和Set8数据集的各种视频修复任务中,始终实现了优异的性能.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are as follows: • We propose TINDER , a novel zero-shot video restoration framework with image diffusion priors, where the initial noise is obtained via DDIM inversion to maintain the temporal relation in the degraded video frames. • We propose an adaptive noise blending strategy to eliminate the degradation pattern in inversion noise for better restoration, followed by a measurement-guided trajectory attention to further guarantee the temporal consistency. • Extensive experiments on multiple video restoration tasks demonstrate our methods outperform existing competing approaches on the DAVIS, REDS4, and Set8 datasets.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献如下: 我们提出TINDER,一个带有图像传播前期的新式零镜头视频恢复框架,其中最初的噪音是通过DDIM反演获得的,以维持退化视频帧的时间关系. 我们提出了一个适应性噪声混合战略,以消除反向噪声的降解模式,从而更好地恢复,然后是测量引导轨迹,以进一步保证时间的一致性。 • 多项视频恢复任务的广泛试验显示,我们的方法优于DAVIS、REDS4和Set8数据集的现有竞争方法。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Conditional Diffusion for Video Restoration
blocks.zh: II-A 视频修复有条件的传播

blocks.en:
Denoising diffusion probabilistic models [ 2 , 28 , 29 , 3 , 4 , 30 , 31 ] have been proven to be a powerful class of unconditional generative models for high-quality image synthesis.
This iterative denoising mechanism not only results in high-fidelity and diverse image synthesis but also establishes a flexible framework that can be extended to various conditional tasks.
Building on their remarkable success in unconditional image generation, researchers have adapted these models for conditional settings by incorporating additional inputs such as degraded images.
This adaptation allows the model to generate outputs that are not only photorealistic but also context-specific, making them particularly well-suited for video restoration tasks where preserving spatial detail and temporal coherence is critical [ 15 , 32 , 16 ] .
Traditional video restoration methods [ 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 , 37 , 38 , 39 , 40 , 41 ] typically employ deterministic mappings that learn a fixed transformation from degraded to restored frames.
Recent representative approaches employ Transformer architectures to capture long-range spatio-temporal dependencies while explicitly addressing motion and alignment across frames.
For instance, VRT [ 40 ] presents a Transformer-based framework with spatio-temporal attention and alignment mechanisms for high-quality video restoration, and RVRT [ 41 ] further improves temporal modeling and efficiency via a recurrent formulation with guided deformable attention for correspondence-aware feature aggregation under complex motion.
Benefiting from task-specific supervision, these end-to-end methods typically achieve strong performance and fast feed-forward inference when the target degradation and data distribution match the training setting. In contrast, diffusion-based approaches embrace a probabilistic framework that models the full underlying distribution of clean video frames.
This probabilistic nature enables the model to capture intrinsic variability and uncertainty, leading to more robust restoration outcomes even in challenging conditions.
Several studies have explored the application of diffusion models in video restoration.
For instance, Zhou et al. [ 15 ] introduced Upscale-A-Video, a text-guided latent diffusion framework for video upscaling that ensures temporal coherence through integrated temporal layers and a flow-guided recurrent latent propagation module.
Similarly, SATeCo [ 32 ] leverages spatial-temporal guidance extracted from low-resolution videos to calibrate the high-resolution video denoising and restoration.
blocks.zh:
排除扩散概率模型[2,28,29,3,4,30,31]已被证明是高品质图像合成的强类无条件基因模型.
这种迭代调试机制不仅导致高真实度和多样的图像合成,而且还建立了一个灵活的框架,可以扩展到各种有条件的任务.
研究人员在无条件生成图像方面取得显著成功的基础上,通过吸收退化图像等额外投入,对这些模型进行了有条件设置的调整。
这一修改使模型能够产生不仅具有光现实性而且符合具体情况的产出,使其特别适合进行视频修复任务,因为保持空间细节和时间一致性至关重要[15、32、16]。
传统的视频恢复方法[33、34、35、36、37、38、39、40、41]通常采用确定性绘图,学习从退化到恢复的框架的固定转变。
最近的代表性方法采用变形器架构来捕捉长距离的时空依赖,同时明确处理跨框架的运动和对齐问题。
例如,VRT[40]提出了一个基于变形器的框架,其中包含对视频高质量恢复的时空关注和调整机制,RVRT[41]通过一种反复使用的配方进一步改善了时间建模和效率,并引导可变形的注意,以便在复杂运动下对函电感知特征进行汇总。
这些端到端方法从特定任务监督中受益,在目标退化和数据分布与培训环境相匹配时,通常能实现强效和快速反馈推论。 与此相反,基于传播的方法包括一个概率框架,用以模拟清洁视频帧的充分基本分布。
这种概率性使得模型能够捕捉内在的变异性和不确定性,从而即使在具有挑战性的条件下也会产生更强劲的恢复结果.
若干研究探讨了传播模型在视频修复中的应用.
例如,"周书"等. [15] 引入了Upscale-A-Video,这是一个用于视频升级的文本引导潜在传播框架,通过集成的时间层和流程引导的经常性潜在传播模块确保时间一致性。
同样,SATeCo[32]利用从低分辨率视频中提取的空间时空引导,校准高分辨率视频解析和恢复.

blocks.en: II-B Diffusion Models of Zero-shot Restoration
blocks.zh: II-B 零射还原扩散模型

blocks.en:
Although these task-specific diffusion models excel in narrowly defined problems, they frequently struggle with generalizability across different restoration tasks.
Instead, another line of research tends to leverage pre-trained diffusion networks as generative priors to solve restoration tasks in a zero-shot manner [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 , 42 ] .
blocks.zh:
虽然这些针对具体任务的传播模式在狭义界定的问题上表现突出,但它们经常在不同恢复任务中与普遍性作斗争。
相反,另一行研究倾向于利用预先训练的传播网络作为基因前传,以零镜头的方式解决修复任务[18,19,20,21,22,42].

blocks.en:
Zero-shot Image Restoration. Existing zero-shot approaches typically apply constraints on the intermediate estimation, guiding the generative process to align with the degradation process of each specific image restoration task.
For example, DDNM [ 21 ] uses a range-null space decomposition on the clean image prediction, restricting diffusion to null-space components.
A relaxed constraint is introduced in [ 18 ] by incorporating a least-squares penalty on the data term to ensure data consistency.
In [ 22 ] , a latent diffusion model enforces data consistency by optimizing the intermediate clean image prediction to minimize the data term during reverse sampling.
DPS [ 19 ] further extends diffusion models to general nonlinear inverse problems by introducing a manifold-constrained gradient approximation, enabling wide applicability to noisy cases.
Additionally, DDPG [ 42 ] proposes an iterative-preconditioned guidance approach that smoothly transitions from back-projection to least-squares gradient steps, enhancing noise robustness in image restoration tasks.
blocks.zh:
零镜头图像修复. 现有的零镜头方法通常对中间估计施加限制,指导基因过程与每个特定图像恢复任务的降解过程保持一致.
例如,DDNM[21]在干净的图像预测上使用范围-null空间分解,将扩散限制在空格元件上.
[18] 在数据术语上加入最低平方位的处罚,以确保数据的一致性,从而引入了宽松的制约。
在[22]中,一个潜在的扩散模型通过优化中间清洁图像预测,在反向采样过程中将数据术语最小化,从而实现数据一致性.
DPS [19] 进一步将扩散模型扩展到一般的非线性反向问题,采用多种受约束的梯度近似法,从而能够广泛适用于吵闹的病例.
此外,DDPG[42]提出了一种具有迭代前提的指导方法,从后期预测顺利过渡到最小平方梯度步骤,增强图像恢复任务的噪声强度.

blocks.en:
Zero-shot Video Restoration. Building on the successes in image restoration, recent studies have explored extending these techniques to video data.
Zero-shot video restoration presents unique challenges due to the need for maintaining temporal consistency across frames where simple frame-by-frame restoration methods often fail to address, leading to noticeable temporal flickering.
To overcome this, Cao et al. [ 23 ] modify a pre-trained image diffusion model by incorporating cross-previous-frame attention layers.
This adaptation explicitly models inter-frame dependencies, thereby mitigating flickering and ensuring that temporal features are coherently maintained across the sequence.
Yeh et al. [ 43 ] introduce hierarchical latent warping to leverage pre-trained image restoration diffusion models for video restoration.
Kwon et al. [ 1 ] proposed a video inverse solver that utilizes image diffusion models, introducing a batch-consistent diffusion sampling strategy to ensure consistency across batches.
However, existing works only adopt a simple noise initiation, struggling to achieve temporal consistent results.
In this paper, we propose to initiate obtaining a temporal-correlated noise by exploiting the temporal correlation inherent in the degraded video, which provides crucial guidance for the restoration process.
blocks.zh:
零镜头视频恢复. 在图像修复成功的基础上,最近的研究探讨了将这些技术推广到视频数据。
零镜头视频恢复带来了独特的挑战,因为需要保持跨帧时间的一致性,而简单的逐帧恢复方法往往不能解决,导致明显的时间闪烁。
为了克服这一点,曹 al等. [23] 修改一个预先训练的图像传播模型,将跨前帧的注意层纳入其中.
这种适应明确模拟了框架之间的依赖性,从而减少闪烁,并确保时间特征在整个序列中得到一致维护。
叶赫等人. [43] 引入分级潜伏曲,以利用预先训练的图像恢复传播模型进行视频恢复.
权健等. [1] 提出了使用图像传播模型的视频反向解析器,引入了批量一致的传播取样策略,以确保各批次的一致性.
然而,现有工作只采用简单的噪音启动,努力取得时间上一致的结果。
在本文中,我们提议通过利用退化的视频中固有的时间相关性,开始获得与时间有关的噪音,这为恢复进程提供了至关重要的指导。

blocks.en: III-A DDIM Inversion
blocks.zh: III-A DDIM 反演

blocks.en: IV-A Overall Framework
blocks.zh: 四. A 总框架

blocks.en:
The proposed framework aims to solve the video restoration problem while only necessitating a pre-trained image diffusion model without re-tuning for each specific task. As shown in Figure 2 , our framework can be divided into three main components: 1) DDIM inversion for initial noise generation, 2) adaptive noise blending for degradation pattern mitigation, and 3) sampling with trajectory attention for temporal consistency enhancement. In contrast to the existing works [ 1 , 23 ] where the Gaussian noise is adopted as the starting point of diffusion sampling, we initiate the restoration process by obtaining temporal-correlated noises via performing DDIM inversion on the input video frames, denoted as 𝒳 T = { 𝒙 T i } i = 1 N = { DDIM i ​ n ​ v ​ ( 𝒚 i ) } i = 1 N \mathcal{X}_{T}=\{\bm{x}_{T}^{i}\}^{N}_{i=1}=\{\textit{DDIM}_{inv}(\bm{y}^{i})\}^{N}_{i=1} .
With the merit of DDIM inversion, the temporal correlation across each frame in the input video 𝒴 \mathcal{Y} can be encoded into the initial inversion noise 𝒳 T \mathcal{X}_{T} , thus offering effective guidance for the subsequent restoration process.
However, as the initial noise 𝒳 T \mathcal{X}_{T} is derived from the input degraded video, the undesired degradation pattern can also be preserved and encoded through the DDIM inversion.
Thus, directly performing diffusion sampling starting from 𝒳 T \mathcal{X}_{T} could cause significant artifacts and hinder the restored results, as shown in Figure 3 .
To address this issue, we propose an adaptive noise blending strategy to mitigate the encoded degradation in initial inversion noise (Section IV-B ).
Lastly, we further propose a measurement-guided trajectory attention mechanism (Section IV-C ) to achieve temporal
consistent restoration during diffusion sampling.

blocks.en: IV-B Adaptive Noise Blending
blocks.zh: IV-B 适应性噪音组合

blocks.en:
In the context of video restoration, the noise is initialized via performing DDIM inversion on the degraded video frames.
The inverted noise contains significant degradation patterns and directly adopting it for sampling will lead to sub-optimal restoration results.
Figure 4 (a) and (c) present the image and frequency domain of the inverted noises using a degraded frame and corresponding clean frame, respectively.
The initial inversion noise contains noticeable jagged patterns with details being smeared out compared to the corresponding ground truth (GT) inversion noise.
This discrepancy is particularly pronounced in the frequency domain, where high frequencies are either completely lost or distorted, compelling the restoration process to infer or amplify the missing information.
We can notice that the low frequency components of initial inversion noise are relatively accurate compared to the high frequency.
Based on this observation, one may trivially adopt a pre-defined low-pass filter (LPF) to perform filtering on the initial inversion noise, which is common sense.
However, video is known for its dynamic content , with significant variations in frequency distribution even between frames of the same video. Therefore, directly applying a uniform pre-defined LPF across different frames would yield suboptimal results.

blocks.en:
Why it works? The proposed noise blending strategy aims to adaptively remove the degradation pattern encoded in the initial DDIM inversion noise and provide reliable information for the subsequent restoration process.
The merits of this strategy can be categorized into two aspects: • First, the adaptive noise blending strategy enables a dynamic filtering according to the energy distribution of each frame with a single energy parameter η \eta . • Besides, this adaptive filtering mitigates artifacts in the inversion noise by preserving the relatively accurate low-frequency and restoring high-frequency components via Gaussian blending, which yields a more balanced initialization that better matches the diffusion prior.

这一策略的优点可分为两个方面: 第一,适应性噪声混合策略能够根据每个帧的能量分布进行动态过滤,并有一个单一的能量参数 \\ eta。 此外,这种适应性过滤通过保存相对准确的低频和通过高斯混音恢复高频组件,减轻了反向噪声中的文物,从而产生更平衡的初始化,更符合先前的传播。

blocks.en: V-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: V-A 实验设置

blocks.en:
Datasets and tasks. To evaluate the efficacy of the proposed method, we conducted comprehensive experiments across three video datasets: DAVIS [ 46 ] , REDS4 [ 47 ] , and Set8 [ 48 ] .
For each dataset, we sampled 100 16-frame video clips as the ground truth for evaluation.
To demonstrate the generalization capability of our method, we conduct three representative video restoration tasks including Gaussian deblur, super-resolution (SR), and inpainting.
Following [ 1 , 18 ] , the degradation is performed using 2 × \times and 4 × \times bicubic down-sampling for SR.
For Gaussian deblurring, a blur kernel of sized 13 × \times 13 with a standard deviation of 2.0 is employed.
For video inpainting, we randomly drop 70 % \% pixels in each video frame.
blocks.zh:
数据集与任务. 为了评价拟议方法的功效,我们进行了三个视频数据集的全面试验:DAVIS [46]、REDS4 [47]和Set8 [48]。
对每个数据集,我们抽样抽取了100个16帧视频片段,作为评估的基础真相。
为了展示我们方法的通俗化能力,我们进行了三项有代表性的视频修复任务,包括高斯德布卢尔,超级分辨率(SR),以及涂漆.
在[1,18]之后,降解使用2××时间和4××时间双立式下取样为SR进行.
对于Gaussian deblurring,采用了一个大小为13×\times 13的模糊内核,标准偏差为2.0.
对于视频涂装,我们随机将70%的像素降入每个视频帧.

blocks.en:
Metrics. For video restoration tasks, evaluating both distortion and perceptual quality is crucial.
Thus, we employ the Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) to assess the fidelity of the restored videos.
For perceptual quality, we use the Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) distance [ 51 ] .
Additionally, a video-specific metric, namely Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) [ 52 ] is utilized for comprehensive evaluation.
blocks.zh:
度量衡. 对于视频修复任务,评价扭曲和视觉质量至关重要。
因此,我们使用峰信号对噪比(PSNR)和结构相似性指数(SSIM)来评估恢复的视频的忠实性.
对于知觉质量,我们使用学习知觉图像补丁相似度(LPIPS)距离[51].
此外,还采用了一个针对录像的衡量标准,即Fréchet录像距离[52]用于综合评价。

The total iterations for the DDIM inversion are fixed at T i ​ n ​ v = 20 T_{inv}=20 for each task and implementation.
For tasks such as Gaussian deblurring and 2 × \times SR, the sampling iteration step is set to T = 20 T=20 .

blocks.en:
The proposed method and all competing baselines necessitate a pre-trained image diffusion as the prior.
To conduct a fair comparison, we adopt the same pre-trained diffusion model sourced from [ 30 ] for all experiments.
The hyper-parameter setting is listed in Table II .
The parameter η \eta controls the energy partition preserved during the adaptive noise blending.
For a task with less degradation severity, the η \eta can be relatively high, e.g., around 0.7, indicating that we can preserve more energy in the DDIM inversion noise to maintain the correlation across each frame.
In contrast, for those tasks with severe degradation, e.g., 4 × \times SR and 70 % \% inpainting, the η \eta should be relatively low ( η = 0.1 \eta=0.1 ) since the inverted noise contains significant degradation.
Therefore, a smaller η \eta indicating more aggressive filtering is required to remove the severe degradation pattern encoded in the inversion noises.

blocks.en: V-C Comparison with State-of-the-Art
blocks.zh: 与艺术国家比较

blocks.en:
To evaluate the performance of our proposed method, we conduct a comparison with several state-of-the-art zero-shot video restoration methods.
Since zero-shot video restoration is an under-explored yet challenging area, there are limited works available to compare 2 2 2 Recent works [ 23 ] and [ 53 ] do not release the codes for comparison. .
Kwon et al. [ 1 ] is the most related work in this task, where the method adopts an identical Gaussian noise as the initiation and utilizes DDS [ 45 ] to ensure data consistency during the diffusion sampling process.
To conduct a comprehensive evaluation, we constructed various competing baselines that utilized different noise initial strategies, namely frame-wise independent noise, mix noise model [ 49 ] , progressive noise model [ 49 ] .
To conduct a fair comparison, all of these baselines including our method adopt the same sampling strategy for data consistency, namely DDS [ 45 ] .

为了进行全面评估,我们构建了各种相互竞争的基线,使用了不同的噪声初始策略,即框架式独立噪声,混合噪声模型[49],渐进噪声模型[49].
为了进行公平的比较,所有这些基线,包括我们的方法,都采用了相同的数据一致性取样战略,即数据数据交换[45]。

blocks.en:
Table I presents the quantitative evaluation results of our proposed method compared to several state-of-the-art approaches, including Gaussian deblur, super-resolution (2× and 4×), and inpainting tasks on the DAVIS, REDS4, and Set8 datasets. For Gaussian deblurring, our approach achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM values with lower LPIPS and FVD compared to other methods, indicating better detail preservation and perceptual quality. In the super-resolution tasks, our method shows significant improvement for the 2× scaling factor, particularly in PSNR and SSIM. However, for the more challenging 4× super-resolution, some results are less consistent, though our method still maintains competitive perceptual quality. For video inpainting, our method achieves superior results in PSNR and SSIM on all datasets. Overall, the results in Table 1 demonstrate that our method generally outperforms or is highly competitive with existing zero-shot video restoration techniques, highlighting its robustness and generalization ability. To further demonstrate the advantage of our method against other competing baselines, Figure 5 provides qualitative comparisons on various video restoration tasks.
Existing methods only adopt a simple noise initiation strategy, leading to significant speckling artifacts across restored frames.
With the merits of the proposed framework, our method consistently aligns closely with the ground truth across all tasks, suggesting robustness that handles various types of image restoration effectively.

As described in Algorithm 1 , our framework can easily extend existing image-based diffusion sampling strategies to solve video restoration problems with data consistency.
To further demonstrate the generalizability and robustness of the proposed method, we conduct extensive experiments by plug-in DiffPIR [ 18 ] into our framework on various video datasets.
Following the previous section, we construct competing baseline using DiffPIR combined with frame-wise independent noise, mix noise model [ 49 ] , progressive noise model [ 49 ] and frame-wise identical noise [ 1 ] . Table III presents the quantitative results using DiffPIR sampling. The proposed method consistently outperforms or remains highly competitive with other approaches across various restoration tasks on all datasets, with particular strength in the LPIPS and FVD.

blocks.en:
To evaluate the robustness of our proposed method, we analyze the restoration stability of our method compared to competing method [ 1 ] across three datasets.
As shown in Table IV , our method shows superior stability across all datasets, with lower standard deviations in all metrics.
For example, on the DAVIS dataset, we not only improve the PSNR from 27.92 to 29.43 but also reduce its standard deviation from ± \pm 0.0912 to ± \pm 0.0020.
Similar trends are observed for SSIM and LPIPS on the DAVIS dataset, as well as for all three metrics on the REDS4 and Set8 datasets.
These results validate that our noise initialization strategy not only enhances restoration quality but also ensures more reliable and consistent performance.

例如,在DAVIS数据集上,我们不仅将PSNR从27.92改进为29.43,而且将其标准偏差从±\pm 0.0912降至±pm 0.0020.
DAVIS数据集上的SSIM和LPIPS,以及REDS4和Set8数据集上的所有三个度量衡都观察到了类似的趋势.
这些结果证实,我们的噪声初始化战略不仅提高了恢复质量,而且确保了更可靠和更一致的业绩。

blocks.en: V-F Ablation Study
blocks.zh: V-F 关系研究

blocks.en:
To investigate the efficacy of each key component of the proposed method, we perform experiments on several variants on the REDS4 dataset.
The ablation comparison starts with a base model employing independent noise initiation alongside DDS sampling.
We incrementally integrated additional components into the framework, specifically DDIM Inversion, Adaptive Noise Blending (ANB), and Measurement-Guided Trajectory Attention (MGTA).
The results in Table V indicate that using all components together provides the best balance across all metrics, achieving notably low LPIPS and FVD scores, indicative of superior perceptual quality and visual accuracy.
Specifically, utilizing DDIM inversion for noise initiation can effectively improve the PSNR while also introducing unnatural patterns that distort the perceptual quality.
However, with the aid of the proposed modules, such drawbacks can be significantly mitigated, achieving promising performance in both fidelity and visual quality.
Figure 6 illustrates a visual comparison on Gaussian deblur on the DAIVIS dataset where each key component of our method is removed.
It clearly demonstrates that without these components, the restoration results suffer from pronounced degradation and noticeable blurring artifacts.
blocks.zh:

To further explore the effectiveness of the proposed measurement-guided trajectory attention mechanism, we conducted additional ablation studies.
Unlike existing methods in video editing [ 24 , 26 , 25 ] which apply spatial-temporal attention during both the inversion and sampling phases, our studies suggest that employing the proposed attention mechanism exclusively during the sampling process enhances restoration performance.
We conduct an ablation study where the DDIM inversion is performed with and without the proposed attention mechanism.
Table VIII shows the results of the aforementioned two variants on Gaussian deblur on three different datasets.
These findings indicate that using the measurement-guided trajectory attention during the inversion process actually hinder the performance, as it reinforces degradation patterns within the frames.
As for video editing, the DDIM inversion is performed on the clean video frames, thus leveraging the spatial-temporal attention will benefit the temporal correlation.
In contrast, in the context of video restoration, the inversion process is performed on the degraded frames.
Consequently, imposing such a temporal-related attention mechanism during the DDIM inverse process will also exploit the correlation across the degradation pattern in each frame, thus hindering restoration performance.

我们进行一项消毒研究,在其中进行DDIM反演时,无论是否采用拟议的注意机制。

至于视频编辑,DDIM反演是在干净的视频帧上进行的,因此利用时空的注意力将有利于时间相关性.
与此相反,在视频恢复方面,倒置过程是在退化的帧上进行的.
因此,在DDIM逆向过程中强制建立这种与时间有关的关注机制,也会利用每个框架的降解模式之间的关联性,从而阻碍恢复工作。

blocks.en: V-G Limitations
blocks.zh: V-G 限制

blocks.en:
Our method improves zero-shot restoration quality and stability through enhanced noise initialization and trajectory-guided temporal attention.
However, it also introduces additional computational overhead.
Compared with the previous method [ 45 ] , our current implementation is slower in wall-clock time under the same experimental setting.
The previous method [ 45 ] takes 9.67 s per video, whereas our full pipeline takes 20.18 s per video.
This increase is mainly due to the proposed components required by our framework, including DDIM inversion for obtaining the initial noise, as well as extra operations such as adaptive noise blending and trajectory attention.
Specifically, the measurement-guided trajectory attention introduces a modest overhead in both runtime and memory, with around +1.94 s runtime and +500 MB memory overhead.
Future work includes accelerating the pipeline by reducing the number of sampling steps, adopting faster initialization strategies, caching or reusing trajectories, and exploring acceleration techniques to obtain a faster feed-forward variant while preserving the proposed stability benefits.

今后的工作包括:通过减少采样步骤的数量来加快管道,采取更快的初始化战略,缓冲或再利用轨迹,探索加速技术,以获得更快的饲料前进变体,同时保留拟议的稳定性效益.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we present a novel zero-shot video restoration framework that only leverages a pre-trained image diffusion model.
We initiate by obtaining correlated noise via DDIM inversion, which can effectively capture and utilize the inherent temporal correlation in the degraded video frames.
Based on that, we propose an adaptive noise blending strategy to remove the degradation pattern encoded during the inversion process while steering the noise toward the Gaussian distribution to enhance the generation ability.
We further propose a measurement-guided trajectory attention to emphasize the temporal consistency during the restoration process.
Finally, extensive experiments on various video restoration tasks demonstrate the superiority of the proposed methods on DAVIS, REDS4 and Set8 datasets.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出了一个新的零镜头视频修复框架,这个框架只能利用预先训练过的图像传播模型.
我们首先通过DDIM反演获得相关噪音,这可以有效地捕捉和利用退化视频帧中固有的时间相关性。
在此基础上,我们提出一个适应性噪声混合策略,去除在反演过程中编码的退化模式,同时引导噪声向高斯分布方向发展,以提高生成能力.
我们进一步提议以测量为导向的轨迹注意,强调恢复过程中的时间一致性。
最后,对各种视频修复任务的广泛试验表明,DAVIS、REDS4和Set8数据集上的拟议方法具有优越性。
